1. Wrote prototype CD burning NFT contract for Songcamp (private repo for now but will OSS when they're ready). 2. Put Juicebox Metadata Updater into production (https://github.com/nnnnicholas/juicebox-metadata-updater/). It keeps the JBProjects 721 and Juicebox Cards 1155 onchain metadata cache refreshed on OpenSea at a given interval, with leaky bucket pinging, a failed request retry queue, a Healthchecks.io email ping if its down for more than a given amount of time, and an Express API to force update. 3. Completed and launched https://juicebox.cards. 4. Next up I plan to simplify the JB Metadata Updater and make it into a more useful generic pm2 script / cron job which should be useful for any onchain NFT project whose metadata changes over time, and wants their metadata to be up to date on OpenSea (which doesn't offer a "collection refresh" endpoint).
